directory.name: Downtown Romio's Pizza & Pasta
directory.note: Longtime Pike Street pizza and pasta shop (in business 27+ years) known for Greek-influenced toppings like gyro meat, olives and feta; trades as 'Downtown Romio's' per its own branding and social pages, though the King County permit is filed as 'Romio'S Pizza & Pasta'.

directory.name: Seattle Pizza & Bar
directory.note: Pizza-forward restaurant with a full bar; handcrafted pizzas anchor the menu at both its Belltown (Western Ave) and South Lake Union (Fairview Ave N) locations, which are one business under one record.

directory.name: Smoking Monkey Pizza
directory.note: Wood-fired pizzeria with a Magnolia storefront plus sister locations in Renton and Spokane; pizza and calzones from a Woodstone oven are the core menu.

directory.name: Soprano's Pizza & Pasta - Lake City
directory.note: Family-owned Lake City pizza and pasta restaurant with active social/delivery listings as of 2026; distinct business from the on-file Soprano's Antico.

candidateReview.name: Mohi Pizza Dba Hot Slice Pizza
candidateReview.note: Trades as Hot Slice Pizza at 41 Dravus St, already on file as 'Hot Slice Pizza'.

candidateReview.name: Oskar'S Pizza (Kc721)
candidateReview.note: Same food truck business as the on-file 'Oskar's Pizza'; it uses a prep kitchen on Delridge Way SW matching the permit address.

candidateReview.name: Ridge Pizza - Northeast
candidateReview.note: Expansion location of the on-file 'Ridge Pizza' (originally Phinney Ridge, opened 2012); same ownership, with the Northeast site's contact routing through matt@ridgepizza.com.

candidateReview.name: Seattle Super Slices
candidateReview.note: No business currently trades under this exact name beyond an inaccessible Facebook page. The permit address (1727 1st Ave S) is now home to a pizza-by-the-slice shop called Slice Box Pizza, but no source ties the two names together as the same entity.

candidateReview.name: Swing Sandwiches And Pizza
candidateReview.note: Sandwich-and-focaccia counter that also sells well-regarded pizza slices, but sandwiches are billed first in its own name and Yelp categorizes it primarily as Sandwiches, so pizza isn't clearly the core of the business.
